q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of BOPP packing tape per roll?
title: BOPP tape carbon footprint per roll
short: Weigh the BOPP film, adhesive and paper core in a roll and multiply each by its supplier's per-kg figure. Add the coating line's fuel and electricity and slitting power, divided by rolls passed. Film and adhesive are usually most of it.

ul: BOPP film by weight per roll, from width, length and micron.
Acrylic water-based or hot-melt adhesive by dry weight.
Paper core and printing ink for printed tape.
Coating line with its drying oven, often heated by fuel.

p: State width, length and film thickness with the figure, since rolls vary widely.

example.title: Worked example: tape plant per roll (one month)
lines: Plant total: 40,700 / 500,000 = 0.0814 kg CO2 per roll
Add film, adhesive and cores for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
